style_notes: Late delivery penalty: do not write the delivery date inside the penalty clause. Write it only in the definitions clause, in the form "Term" means <date>, using a capitalised term of your own choice, and in the penalty clause refer to the date only by that term.
Payment terms: write the period as a net period, for example Net 40, and not as "within 40 days".
extra_decoys: The Vendor shall acknowledge each purchase order in writing within fourteen (14) days of receiving it.
